lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eleven senators. Four firms. One holding company whose registered address is a post box in the hills above a shipping city.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The reading is suspended. It will be suspended for eleven years, and in the eleventh year it will pass anyway, with everyone watching.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. Printed, filed, and in a public record that exists in my century too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere downstream, something that has never been surprised in two hundred and eighty years makes a note.
